selectedConcept: D layered silhouette + B reinforcing band ornament
prompt:
Create the FINAL PRODUCTION transparent sprite sheet for the user's selected GD03 shield shard, faithfully extracted/adapted from the approved D+B concept reference.
Reference role: APPROVED DESIGN authority, especially the TWO large objects in its TOP ROW, not the arena or text.
Output: one wide 2:1 RGBA PNG, TWO EQUAL SQUARE CELLS in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, left = red-hot tracking sprite, right = cooled return sprite. Genuine fully transparent background, NO board, no text, no labels, no lines, no checkerboard baked in, no shadows on a backdrop. Each cell contains exactly ONE isolated shield fragment centered at (50%,50%), occupying 78% of cell width, with at least 10% transparent padding on every edge.
The SAME IDENTICAL object, size, silhouette, angle, layer positions, chips, bronze strap and stud in BOTH cells; only material temperature differs. Preserve D's three tightly layered jagged broken iron lamella plates with offset gaps, and B's simple narrow bronze reinforcement strip and central small circular stud with restrained geometric engraved lines. No large spiral sigil. A chunky compact broken shield component, not a whole shield, not a long dagger, not a rock. No disconnected free-floating chips or particles outside the solid body.
For actual game movement: arrange the compact assembly HORIZONTALLY with its primary jagged pointed leading edge facing RIGHT (local +X), rear split plates fanning slightly LEFT/up/down, overall body aspect about 1.3:1. Keep face visible from a 2D side-view, no top-down isometric view.
Left HOT: visibly cherry-red heated iron plate FACES, red-orange light inside gaps and along broken edges, warm aged bronze strap. Make red-hot surfaces sufficiently bold to read at 24px, not only hairline orange cracks on brown rock. One tight restrained emissive rim; NO baked travel trail, fire tongues, broad glow, sparks or smoke. Right COOLED: extinguished charcoal gunmetal faces, worn bronze strap, crisp pale silver jagged fracture edges for readability against a navy night arena. No red fissures, no emissive glow, no icy blue magic. Same sharp dangerous physical metal.
Style: sharp painterly outlined 2D bronze-and-iron game sprite matching the concept, simplified major readable planes, strong edge definition at small sizes. Clean antialiased alpha edges. Not pixel art, not flat UI icon, not glossy photoreal 3D render. Keep all composition outside the two isolated sprites completely transparent.
spriteImport: Native Sprite Editor capability checks, centered alpha-bounds crops, Hot/Cooled, PPU 200, uncompressed
